description: This plot illustrates the relationship between "Initial Confidence" and "Accuracy" for three distinct metrics, each represented by a line with error bars. The x-axis, labeled "Initial Confidence," features a linear scale ranging from 0.95 to 0.99, with tick marks at intervals of 0.01. The y-axis, labeled "Accuracy," also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks spaced every 0.2. The first line, which has an obscured label in the legend, is a solid blue line with circular markers; it begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.90 at an initial confidence of 0.95, dips slightly to 0.86 at 0.96, rises to a peak of 0.93 at 0.98, and ends at 0.88 at 0.99. The second line, labeled "Δ Acc," is an orange dashed line with diamond markers; it starts at 0.90 at 0.95, dips to 0.86 at 0.96, rises slightly to 0.88 at 0.97, remains relatively steady to 0.87 at 0.98, and then declines to end at 0.75 at 0.99. The third line, labeled "Initial Acc," is a green dash-dot line with square markers; it begins at 0.0 at 0.95, remains flat at 0.0 through 0.96, and then steadily rises, reaching 0.05 at 0.98 and ending at a peak of 0.12 at 0.99.
